Beech Hill Advisors Inc. Has $11.38 Million Stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Posted by Anthony Miller | Feb 5th, 2018 
Beech Hill Advisors Inc. boosted its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.4% during the third quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing with the SEC. The firm owned 73,816 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after acquiring an additional 1,049 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for about 6.0% of Beech Hill Advisors Inc.’s portfolio, making the stock its biggest holding. Beech Hill Advisors Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $11,377,000 as of its most recent filing with the SEC. 
A number of other institutional investors also recently added to or reduced their stakes in the stock. JFS Wealth Advisors LLC raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 11.7% during the 3rd quarter. JFS Wealth Advisors LLC now owns 33,733 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $5,199,000 after acquiring an additional 3,544 shares during the period. Bainco International Investors raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 6.2% during the 3rd quarter. Bainco International Investors now owns 121,166 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $18,674,000 after acquiring an additional 7,127 shares during the period. Cable Hill Partners LLC raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 10.6% during the 3rd quarter. Cable Hill Partners LLC now owns 13,405 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,066,000 after acquiring an additional 1,288 shares during the period. Linscomb & Williams Inc. raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 4.0% during the 3rd quarter. Linscomb & Williams Inc. now owns 53,934 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $8,312,000 after acquiring an additional 2,060 shares during the period. Finally, Markel Corp raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 9.7% during the 3rd quarter. Markel Corp now owns 113,100 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $17,431,000 after acquiring an additional 10,000 shares during the period. 60.26% of the stock is currently owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. Several analysts recently issued reports on AAPL shares. Macquarie set a $188.00 price objective on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Friday, January 26th. ValuEngine upgraded shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating in a report on Sunday, December 31st. Zacks Investment Research upgraded shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $197.00 price objective on the stock in a report on Thursday, January 18th. Barclays lowered their price objective on Apple from $174.00 to $170.00 and set an “equal weight” rating for the company in a research report on Friday. Finally, Piper Jaffray Companies reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $200.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, January 2nd. Two research analysts have   sell rating, fourteen have issued a hold rating, thirty-five have given a buy rating and two have given a strong buy rating to the stock. Apple presently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $202.53. 
Shares of Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) opened at $160.50 on Monday. Apple Inc. has a 12 month low of $128.16 and a 12 month high of $180.10. The company has a current ratio of 1.28, a quick ratio of 1.23 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.73. The firm has a market capitalization of $824,060.00, a P/E ratio of 16.51, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.30 and a beta of 1.33. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a return on equity of 37.84% and a net margin of 21.13%. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. During the same quarter last year, the firm earned $3.36 EPS. Apple’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. equities research analysts forecast that Apple Inc. will post 11.3 earnings per share for the current year. 
The firm also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 15th. Shareholders of record on Monday, February 12th will be paid a dividend of $0.63 per share. The ex-dividend date is Friday, February 9th. This represents a $2.52 dividend on an annualized basis and a yield of 1.57%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio (DPR) is presently 25.93%.
